scope: Phase four: structure, object-array, text and nested-value editing
status: Implemented; nested-value regressions pass. Final full CTest is 123/124 due to an unresolved native file-menu crash; timing acceptance remains pending.
implemented: Public C interface version 12 adds copied named records and child-editor composition. It exposes no STL, SDK, SDL, ImGui or owned native pointers. Records are bounded to 64 levels, 4096 members and 65536 total fields, with aggregate text/array budgets and atomic rejection.

The core ParameterValue description owns recursive structure, UTF-8 text and full-generation object-array values. Member shape, order, type GUID and object identity are validated; setters update existing member instances.

Container renderers compose selected child editors through the parent sink. Inline interactions retain one complete parent draft and submit one parent modification; cancellation preserves the value, Dirty and Redo.

Native dialogs retain their original working-copy layouts and controls through the registered renderers. Each supported subtree has one owned logical value; member rows resolve paths into it. Child cancellation restores only that interaction while retaining earlier accepted child edits; Apply commits the whole dialog once.

Native array names/IDs/classes/dynamic flags, selection, copying/pasting, ordering, delete, chooser and object setup remain available. Native string single-line and multiline presentation is preserved.

Query, modifier and nested renderer selections are captured for an open interaction. An independently compiled module replaces the structure query/modifier/renderer, composes an independently selected vector editor, and continues using the original selection after reconfiguration.

Setters that partially modify a structure before rejection or exception compensate the entire value. Undo data stores before/after values and native member identities; all nested object references participate in history retention.

Unmanaged native bytes and opaque plugin values retain their existing copier/state representation through parameter.copy-value, joining the enclosing edit. A curve-containing structure is covered without replacing its member identities. ParameterBox no longer submits independent per-member edits.

The former private ParameterValue/ParameterValueAction definitions in ValueCommands are renamed to StoredParameterValue/StoredParameterValueAction to avoid conflicting with the common typed model. No causal link to native crashes is claimed.
No SDK source or viewport rendering/transfer implementation changed. Existing SDK patches and untracked content are unchanged.

An empty copied record is accepted at the declared depth limit; the next level is refused atomically. Inline object arrays end their clipped list before drawing Add Object; their standalone native UI regression covers reordering, deletion, undo and cancelled selection.

full_ctest.note: All new value-editing cases pass. The file-menu group crashes in AppKit destruction after its assertions. Fifteen later UI process launches display the macOS restore-windows prompt; it was dismissed to continue. This is not a clean automated full pass.

targeted_before_depth_regression.note: Final full run also passes the deep-structure regression added afterward.

deep_structure.note: Reproduced refusal at the former copied-record depth limit; the complete schema now fits and the value undoes in one step.

checks.core_cases: Forty nested updates before one commit; cancel and Redo/Dirty preservation; child identity preservation on undo/redo; incomplete records; setters that mutate then reject or throw; working-copy compensation; stale array/member generations; reordered arrays; opaque curve-container copy/no-change/undo/redo; thirty-level query and undo; recursive C ownership, move and output copying; aggregate limits and cyclic records. The 64-level empty-record boundary is accepted and a 65th level is rejected without changing the receiver.
